title: Business Days Calculator
seoTitle: Free Business Days Calculator — Count Working Days Online
description: Count the number of business days between two dates, excluding weekends. Optionally skip the end date. Private and free.
intro: Select a start and end date to see how many weekdays fall between them. Useful for project timelines, shipping estimates and payroll.
blurb: Calculate working days between two dates, skipping weekends.
howItWorks: Choose a start date and an end date.
The tool counts Mondays through Fridays between them.
Optionally include or exclude the end date. Weekends are always skipped.
examples: From Monday to Friday of the same week is 5 business days.
A 10-calendar-day span that includes a weekend is usually 8 business days.
Helpful for estimating delivery windows or leave calculations.

faq.q: Does it account for public holidays?
faq.a: Not automatically. It only skips Saturdays and Sundays. You can subtract known holidays manually.
Yes. Dates are processed only in your browser.

faq.q: What if the end date is before the start date?
faq.a: The tool will show a clear message so you can correct the order.
